text:
sabrina: Seeing ~40% throughput drop in eu-west-1 inference pool since 12:03UTC. Multiple worker restarts and a few GPU OOMs. Routing: redwood-inference/eu-west-1/gpu-pool. Can someone triage? :rotating_light:

infra-bot: [ALERT] region=eu-west-1 metric=throughput drop=41% workers_restarts=18 gpu_oom=3

omar: grabbing profiler traces now. Any recent runtime changes in that pool?

sabrina: we pushed a kernel-heuristic tweak ~2h ago (prefer small-batch int8 kernels for latency). No other infra rollouts. Logs excerpt: ```
[12:02:57] worker-142 ERROR gpu-oom: allocation failed: out of memory
[12:02:58] worker-142 WARN restarting worker
[12:03:05] router INFO incoming: tenant=team-x batch_size=12 seq=2048
```

lee: that heuristic bump is suspicious. It tries to pick int8 fastpath for batches <= 16 but doesn't consider KV cache residency. For large seqs (2k) int8 path ramps memory usage -> fragmentation.

aj: monitoring shows KV cache eviction spike at the same time: evict_rate: "3200/s" (baseline ~"120/s"). Also hotpage sweep rate increased. Likely compaction can't keep up, causing allocator fragmentation and eventual OOM.

omar: profiler snapshot (short): ```
kernel_choice: fastpath-int8 (a few toggles to fallback-fp16)
mem_usage: 11.9GB -> 13.8GB (within 30s)
kv_cache_resident: 74% -> 41%
batch_distribution: small=70%, medium=25%, large=5% (but large sessions keep hot KV)
```

natalie: two practical mitigations: 1) force kernel hint to fp16 on eu-west-1 worker pool so it avoids aggressive int8 path; 2) throttle noisy tenant (team-x) while we run compaction heuristics. Also consider temporarily raising KV cache size if capacity allows.

sabrina: agree. I'll apply kernel_hint=fp16 route tag and throttle team-x to 10 qps. Executing now.

oncall: commands executed: ```
# set env for deployment group
kubectl -n eu-west-1 set env deploy/worker KERNEL_HINT=fp16 --overwrite
# throttle route for tenant
redwoodctl routes update --tenant team-x --qps 10 --region eu-west-1
```
Command outputs: ```
deployment.apps/worker env updated
routes: updated tenant=team-x qps=10
```

deploy-bot: hotfix deployment v2026.03.18-euw-kernel-hint started -> succeeded (workers rolled, 6 pods at a time)

sabrina: after the hotfix: throughput back to ~95% baseline within 6 minutes, worker restarts stopped, no new GPU OOMs seen in the past 12 minutes. KV eviction rate fell to ~150/s.

omar: captured follow-up perf trace and flamegraph for the 12:03->12:12 window and saved to infra storage: s3://redwood-telemetry/eu-west-1/2468001234/trace.flame.html

lee: preliminary root cause: heuristic misclassifying sessions with large KV hotspots as "small-batch" candidates for int8 fastpath. Combined with ongoing fragmentation (from sweeps) this pushed live alloc pattern into pathological slab fragmentation -> OOM + restarts.

aj: action items: 1) revert the aggressive cutoff in the heuristic (limit int8 fastpath to seq_len <=1024 AND kv_residency<50%); 2) add a quick eviction-smoothing limiter so compaction isn't overwhelmed; 3) add alert rule for kv_eviction_rate > 500/s.

natalie: I'll own the rollout of the heuristic rollback as a canary (2% traffic) and the new alert. ETA for canary: ~1hr.

sabrina: nice work. I'll follow up with a short postmortem once we confirm canary. Thanks everyone for quick handling. :thumbsup:
